mechanisms.behavior: The drained ball closes 9. Release 1 feeds it to the manual shooter lane. Start and drain both reset the drop banks before the serve.
mechanisms.label: Outhole and Ball Release

mechanisms.behavior: The left saucer holds the ball on switch 15, awards the selected value or extra ball and ejects on 2.
mechanisms.label: Eject Hole

mechanisms.behavior: Each dropped target stays down. All three down closes the series circuit at 21, and coil 4 resets the bank. Completing the bank advances the magnet award.
mechanisms.label: G-O-R Drop Bank

mechanisms.behavior: The three dropped targets close 41–43 and the all-down series circuit at 44. Coil 3 lifts all three together. The bank advances the jets and the GAR award.
mechanisms.label: G-A-R Drop Bank

mechanisms.behavior: The pit leaf triggers relay 5, which grounds the separate magnet. Output 6 flashes the two type 89 bulbs on its own timing. When 5 opens the magnet releases the ball back to the playfield.
mechanisms.label: Snake Pit

mechanisms.behavior: Cabinet button and flipper relay Z1 gate the dual-wound SFL-20-300 30-800-DC assembly, with a physical EOS contact. PinMAME presents a synthetic output pair.
mechanisms.label: Right Flipper

mechanisms.behavior: Cabinet button and flipper relay Z1 gate the dual-wound SFL-20-300 30-800-DC assembly, with a physical EOS contact. PinMAME presents a synthetic output pair.
mechanisms.label: Left Flipper

mechanisms.behavior: A separate normally open special switch triggers the drive with game-on enabled. The matrix scoring switch reports the hit; PinMAME uses it to synthesize the same drive.
mechanisms.label: Top Jet Bumper
